messages:
sam: Heads-up — after the last merge I'm seeing intermittent failures where Atlantis apply completes but ArgoCD immediately tries to sync and hits a 409/manifest-diff error. Anyone seen this timing/ordering issue?

mira: ugh. saw something similar yesterday on staging. looks like GHA job finishes with success but the post-apply webhook fires before the k8s resources are fully reconciled? :thinking:

diego: can you paste the relevant logs from the apply and the argo sync attempt? might be an annotation/last-applied mismatch.

sam: pasted snippets below — apply job logs show exit 0 then a tiny window later argo sync request returns 409: conflict.
```
atlantis: apply complete for module/service-api (plan#123)
- created deployment/service/configmap
- state written to s3://infra-state/terraform.tfstate
status: success
```
```
argocd: sync request received for app service-api
error: manifest conflict: live object differs from desired (resourceVersion mismatch)
status: 409
```

mira: hmm, that looks like ArgoCD is comparing live vs desired during its initial sync and object meta differs because Terraform added some server-side default fields after creation. Argo then treats that as diff.

sam: is the usual fix to add an argocd.syncOptions: SkipHooks or to add ignoreDifferences for serverDefaulted fields? worried about silencing real drifts.

diego: two approaches: 1) Make Atlantis/GHA wait for k8s server to report ready after apply before triggering argocd, or 2) Configure ArgoCD to normalize server-defaulted fields via resource.customizations or ignoreDifferences for specific fields. 1) is safer imo for infra changes that create resources used by apps.

mira: +1 for wait-and-verify. In our last incident we added a tiny post-apply verify step in GHA that does `kubectl get <resource> -o yaml` and checks resourceVersion / observedGeneration, with a short backoff. then POST the argocd webhook. saved us from 409s.

sam: can you sketch the verify step? I can file a small PR to the infra-ci job.

diego: pseudo: 
```bash
# wait up to 60s for server to report object exists and generation stable
for i in {1..6}; do
  rv=$(kubectl get deploy service-api -o=jsonpath='{.metadata.resourceVersion}' || echo '')
  if [ -n "$rv" ]; then break; fi
  sleep 10
done
# optional: wait for pod template observedGeneration == metadata.generation
```
If resourceVersion present, then trigger argocd webhook.

mira: also add a short jitter before webhook to avoid thundering herd if multiple apps updated. 3-10s random sleep.

sam: ok I'll draft the GH Actions patch: add a post-apply step that runs the kubectl check, plus jitter, then calls the existing argocd webhook.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: noted — automated retries on Argo side will still kick in but this should reduce noise.

ci-bot: CI note: remember to add k8s creds scope to the atlantis-action job if needed (RBAC for read).

mira: thanks — if you want i can review the PR. also we should document the rationale in the infra runbook so future folks don't re-enable immediate webhook.

sam: will do, filing PR now. tagging @mira for review. :thumbsup:
